title: 1973 AHSME Problem 14
statement: Each valve \(A,\) \(B,\) and \(C,\) when open, releases water into a tank at its own constant rate. With all three valves open, the tank fills in \(1\) hour, with only valves \(A\) and \(C\) open it takes \(1.5\) hours, and with only valves \(B\) and \(C\) open it takes \(2\) hours. The number of hours required with only valves \(A\) and \(B\) open is

solutions.text:
Let \(a,\) \(b,\) \(c\) be the hourly rates in tankfuls. Then \[ \begin{aligned} a+b+c&=1,\\ a+c&=\frac23,\\ b+c&=\frac12. \end{aligned} \] Twice the first equation minus the other two gives \[ a+b=2-\frac23-\frac12=\frac56. \] Thus valves \(A\) and \(B\) fill the tank in \[ \frac1{a+b}=\frac65=1.2 \] hours.

Therefore, the correct answer is C.
